# Blanket (`equipment:blanket`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 5 gp | **Weight:** 3 lb.

While wrapped in a blanket, you have Advantage on saving throws against extreme cold (see “Gameplay Toolbox”).
